title: PhD & Postdoc Position in Trustworthy AI (m/f/d)
institution: CRISTAL Lab, CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security
about: The CRISTAL Lab at CISPA, led by Cristina Gârbacea, recruits fully funded PhD students and postdoctoral researchers in trustworthy AI: foundation model alignment, agentic reasoning, personalized preference modeling and safety evaluation. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until 15 December 2026.
requirements: PhD track: master's degree in computer science, data science and AI or a related field
Postdoc track: PhD in a related field
Strong publication track record in relevant venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, COLM)
Apply via the CISPA job portal (PDF uploads, max 3 files); email applications are not accepted

upskill.name: AI Safety & Alignment I
why: "Foundation model alignment" -> "Value alignment: ensuring AI systems act in accordance with human values and intentions"
"Preference modeling" -> "Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF): aligning LLMs to human preferences"
"Safety evaluation" -> "Scalable oversight: supervising AI systems that surpass human capabilities"
